title: Implement a min-heap in Go
description: Implement a min-heap (priority queue) supporting Push, Pop (returns minimum), and Peek operations.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement MinHeap in minheap.go using a slice and sift operations:
- Field: `data []int`
- `Push(v)`: append to data, then sift up from last index
- `Pop()`: if empty return (0, false); swap data[0] with last, shrink slice, sift down from 0; return old root
- `Peek()`: if empty return (0, false); return data[0]
- Sift-up: while i > 0 and data[parent] > data[i], swap and continue from parent
- Sift-down: while left child < len, find smallest child, swap if smaller than current, continue
All 5 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
